thread:
ana.k: Hey team — our quarterly scan flagged ~48 admin entitlements with no recent attestation. Can owners please provide justification or return access by EOD Wed? I exported a sample CSV: https://files.internal/priv-scan/quarterly_1956.csv
rbac-bot: Automated scan results attached. 48 rows labeled HIGH_RISK, 12 svcacct owners missing. See `scan_id: qtr-1956`
sam.t: Thanks Ana. Can we split into two buckets: 1) KMS/keys & 2) infra console/admin? The KMS ones need KMS owner + audit proof.
mohit_patel: For KMS entries, we need a signed ticket referencing the key ARN + a short purpose (prod debug, emergency, etc). Otherwise we revoke.
jess_r: I can own the infra console set — will start contacting owners. Quick Q: what's our evidence format? a) short sentence b) ticket link c) last-use timestamp?
irene: jess — prefer (a) + (b). last-use sometimes noisy. If they can produce a recently used CI job id that helps.
sam.t: Also include whether access is transitive via a group. If so capture the group name. We should prefer reducing direct admin grants.
nana: (typo) — ignore
mohit_patel: Can we extend retention for the audit logs for 30 days for the group we're about to query? I want to pull KMS key usage for the past 90 days but logs only have 60.
anan: @mohit_patel infra can bump retention but need ticket. Please create infra#7892 and tag `audit-retention`
mohit_patel: Filed infra#7892, link: https://tickets.internal/infra/7892 — pinging infra on-call.
jess_r: Quick template I'm sending to owners: "Please confirm why you need admin-level access to <resource>. Provide a single-line justification, link to an open ticket that requires this access (or admit none), and whether this should be converted to a role/group. Reply by <date>." Anyone object?
sam.t: fine. Add a line: "If no response by deadline we will remove access and create a support-only bypass request for emergency re-grant"
jess_r: added. sending now.
rbac-bot: Reminder scheduled: owners will get auto-reminders at 48h and 24h left.
irene: One corner case: a few entries are service accounts marked as 'ownerless' but still have admin perms because they were created by migrations. I propose we rotate keys and replace with least-priv token.
mohit_patel: Agreed. I'll build a small runbook for svcacct key rotation and owner assignment. Posting draft here in 2 days.
nana: double-posted earlier, sorry
anj: FYI — vulnerability triage flagged one user who had admin while their account showed MFA disabled. We should hold that ent before attestation.
ana.k: Good catch. @sam.t please mark that row as BLOCKED until MFA confirmed.
sam.t: marked BLOCKED in the sheet.
jess_r: Can we add a column `evidence_url` to the CSV so we have PII-free links to tickets/screenshots?
mohit_patel: yes — use internal attachments S3 with short-lived links. I'll add instructions in the email template.
irene: After collection, let's run a sampling audit (20%) to manually verify claims vs actual access logs. Want to ensure reviewers aren't just rubber-stamping.
sam.t: Agreed. I'll own the sampling plan. Expect a one-hour spot-check workshop Fri.
jess_r: ACK :thumbsup:
nana: will follow up with folks I know are OOO next week — might need to extend deadlines for them
ana.k: ok thanks. Final note: capture a single Slack thread link in the spreadsheet per owner so we have attestation history. Also escalate any non-responses to manager after deadline.
rbac-bot: Escalation rule: non-response -> manager ping + ticket auto-create (policy: ent-sweep-esc-v1).
mohit_patel: Logging question for @infra on-call: when we remove access, do we annotate the revocation with reason so audits show the justification?
nana: yes, revocation API supports `annotation` field. Include `removed_for_no_attestation` or `replaced_by_role:<role>`
jess_r: Thanks all — I'll post the counts after the first reminder cycle.
irene: cheers, and please add me to any owner replies that look like persistent exceptions.
nana: :wave:
nana: last ping — deadline set to 2026-03-25 23:59 PT
